title: Clay for the Potter
offer: My island has no clay left! The best clay is on the shore of Ekvik. Bring me four baskets, and you get two crates of my pots.

clay.name: Clay
clay.counted: {count|a basket of clay|{count} baskets of clay}

steps.load_say: Grey, sticky clay from the shore. Heavy too!

steps.say: Lovely clay! Squeeze it, smell it... Here are your pots, still warm from the kiln.

fact: The vikings made pots of clay, but the best ones were carved of soapstone.
